title: Add tsgabrielle and fadyabohamza-netizen to the List
author: gggff123

gist.headline: Two More Bees Enter
gist.blurb: The GitHub gate has two new names on its little clipboard. tsgabrielle and fadyabohamza-netizen can now find their way into the hive.
gist.summary: Added the GitHub identities tsgabrielle and fadyabohamza-netizen to the shared authentication allowlist, enabling their approved access.
gist.impact: The two newly listed contributors can now authenticate through the shared GitHub-based access flow.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy hive entrance represented by a small retro terminal gate and a handwritten contributor list, with Polli warmly stamping two new name cards. Tiny code-plants and flowers make the access-control work feel like welcoming contributors into a garden rather than a security checkpoint.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light-blue rounded wings, and a tiny librarian hat, warmly adding two small name cards to a glowing retro terminal's contributor list beside a garden gate; code-plants, flowers, and vines grow around the terminal, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent and simple pixel text reading "WELCOME". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but beautiful.
